mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_cost_alert (request_id, alert_type, alert_level, target_type, budget_type, target_id, message, amount, threshold_value, current_value, severity, status, occurrence_count, fingerprint, last_seen_at) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{alertType}, #{alertLevel}, #{targetType}, #{budgetType}, #{targetId}, #{message}, #{amount}, #{thresholdValue}, #{currentValue}, #{severity}, #{status}, #{occurrenceCount}, #{fingerprint}, #{lastSeenAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_cost_alert ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM ai_cost_alert WHERE fingerprint = #{fingerprint} AND status IN ('OPEN', 'ACKNOWLEDGED') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_cost_alert WHERE status = 'OPEN' AND alert_level = #{level}
